description: This course is designed for students who want to design and manage smart systems that use Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) to improve product and service offerings in enterprises and businesses across different industries. It covers the use of an AI governance framework to ensure the design and deployment of intelligent systems protect individual and organisational interests such as transparency, safety, well-being, fairness, privacy and security. Application areas include AI/ML in smart hospitals, autonomous vehicles, intelligent energy management with edge AI for business and homes, and many more.
